verdict.rationale: Kimi's own help center lists "定时任务" (scheduled tasks) among the assistant's general features, so the product does claim a first-party scheduling capability. The evidence is a single help-index heading with no detail on how it works. It does not say whether tasks can be one-off, recurring, or both, and it does not describe automatic execution or how results come back to the user. Missing for 10: documented recurring-schedule support, documented one-off scheduling, evidence of automatic unattended execution, result delivery/notification back to the user, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results
